استكلبوا (form X)
# اِسْتَكْلَبُوا (istaklabū) /is.tak.la.buː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَكْلَبَ (istaklaba)
# اِسْتَكْلِبُوا (istaklibū) /is.tak.li.buː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَكْلَبَ (istaklaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
